sentences.text:
THIS CRL.P, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MRS JUSTICE M G UMA  ORAL ORDER
Learned counsel for the petitioner is absent.
No representation even when the matter is passed over twice and again called at 3.10 p.m.

The order sheet dated 12.01.2024 reads as under:
"Finally two weeks' time is granted to the learned counsel to furnish annexures,
documents etc. for service of notice to respondent No.2."
Even though notice was ordered to be issued on respondent No.2, till date, required process fee with correct address for issuance of notice to respondent No.2 is not paid.
It appears that that the petitioner is not interested in prosecuting the petition.
Hence, the petition is dismissed for non- prosecution.
In view of the disposal of the main petition, pending IA stands disposed of.

Sd/-
(M G UMA) JUDGE Smt. V. Kanaham vs The State Of Karnataka on 8 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/140689269/
